pages.title: Orichalcum Buckler
pages.text: A projectile-focused buckler with 413 durability. Its blocking window and cooldown are both 1.5 seconds. A blocked projectile returns 1.45 times the blocked damage to its living owner.
The reflection also attempts a short teleport ahead and above you. It checks the destination for collision, so a blocked destination will not force you into solid terrain.
